title: Asset pack
description: Icons and images of an application (ADR-29), already cleaned by the CLI: icons are geometry only, images are base64 content. Published with only the entries the application uses. Icons are named pack/name, images asset:pack/name.

assets.description: Name of the pack, the namespace of its entries (acme in acme/truck), which is also the identifier of the document in the registry.

version.description: Version of the pack as its authors released it, for example 1.2.0.

license.description: Licence of the content, for example "MIT" or "Proprietary, ACME S.p.A.", so that the notices of the application can name it.

description.description: What the pack holds, for the people who choose it.

viewBox.description: Coordinates of the drawing of the icon: min-x, min-y, width and height, for example "0 0 1024 1024".

paths.description: Path data of the icon (the d attribute of an SVG path), drawn in the current text colour. Only geometry: the CLI turns the other shapes into paths and drops the rest.

fillRule.description: How the paths fill their overlaps (nonzero if absent).

viewBox.description: Coordinates of the drawing of the filled form: min-x, min-y, width and height, for example "0 0 1024 1024".

paths.description: Path data of the filled form (the d attribute of an SVG path), drawn in the current text colour. Only geometry: the CLI turns the other shapes into paths and drops the rest.

fillRule.description: How the paths fill their overlaps (nonzero if absent).

filled.description: Filled form of the icon, drawn for a pressed toggle.

keywords.description: Words that find the icon in the icon picker of Studio, for example delivery, shipping.

icons.description: Icons by name: in the JSON of the screens and the navigation they are named pack/name, for example acme/truck.

data.description: Content of the image in base64 (at most about 200 kB); an SVG is cleaned by the CLI like the icons.

alt.description: Default text alternative of the image, used when the screen gives none.

images.description: Images by name, for example the illustration of an empty state or a logo: addressed as asset:pack/name.
